QB.stem: A young boy presents with fever, parotid gland enlargement, and testicular enlargement. Which of the following is the appropriate isolation precaution?
opts: Airborne precautions until 5 days after the onset of fever
Contact precautions until 5 days after the onset of fever
Droplet precautions until 5 days after the onset of fever
Contact precautions until 5 days after the onset of parotid swelling
Droplet precautions until 5 days after the onset of parotid swelling
QB.key: E (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78A)

QB.stem: A 3-year-old girl has dysuria and urinary frequency for 2 days. She is afebrile and well-appearing, and tolerates oral intake. Urinalysis shows pyuria and nitrite positive, and urine culture is pending. Which of the following is the most appropriate antibiotic?
QB.key: C (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78A)

QB.flag: ⚠ ต้นฉบับจดแค่อาการ + ช้อย A. GBS — เติมเวลาเป็นเฉียบพลันและ reflex หายให้ตอบ GBS ได้ข้อเดียว
QB.stem: A 7-year-old boy has a 5-day history of progressive difficulty putting on his shirt and combing his hair. He had an upper respiratory tract infection 2 weeks ago. Examination shows a waddling gait, symmetric weakness of the proximal muscles of all four limbs, and absent deep tendon reflexes. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
QB.key: A Guillain-Barré syndrome (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78A)

QB.stem: A 7-year-old boy is diagnosed with post-streptococcal glomerulonephritis. He has mild periorbital edema, a blood pressure of 110/70 mmHg, and normal serum potassium and creatinine. Which of the following advice is most appropriate?
QB.key: D (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78A)

QB.stem: A 13-year-old boy is brought to clinic because his teacher reports aggressive behavior toward classmates over the past 2 months. Which of the following questions is most appropriate to ask him first?
opts: Have you ever had a girlfriend?
Have you ever had a problem at school?
Who lives with you at home?
QB.key: D (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78A)

QB.stem: A mother is concerned that her 12-year-old daughter spends many hours on social media and has been chatting with strangers online. Which of the following is the most appropriate advice?
opts: Create a family internet plan for checking the browsing history
Supervise all of the daughter's online activities
Limit the daughter's social media use
Educate the daughter about her digital footprint
QB.key: E (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78A)

QB.stem: A newborn has microcephaly, cleft lip and palate, microphthalmia, postaxial polydactyly, and scalp defects over the vertex. Which of the following karyotypes is most consistent with these findings?
QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.stem: An 8-month-old infant has itchy erythematous patches on both cheeks and the extensor surfaces of the arms and legs, with excoriation marks. The lesions are not oozing or crusted. Which of the following is the most appropriate initial management?
QB.key: A Moisturizer (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78A)

QB.stem: A 3-year-old boy with a history of hives after eating eggs comes for influenza vaccination. He has never received an influenza vaccine before. Which of the following is the most appropriate recommendation?
opts: Perform an influenza vaccine skin test before vaccination
Give the vaccine in two divided graded doses
QB.key: B (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78A)

QB.stem: A 6-year-old boy collapses in the emergency department. He is unresponsive, apneic, and pulseless. The cardiac monitor shows a chaotic, irregular waveform with no identifiable QRS complexes. A defibrillator is being brought to the bedside. Which of the following is the most appropriate initial management?
QB.key: A (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78A)

QB.stem: A 2-year-old girl is brought to the emergency department because she looks drowsy. Her pulse rate is 50/min, respiratory rate is 10/min with shallow breaths, and oxygen saturation is 82% on room air. Which of the following is the most appropriate initial management?
QB.key: A (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78A)

QB.stem: A 4-year-old boy is brought to the emergency department 1 hour after swallowing a small sealed plastic bag containing methamphetamine tablets. He is alert, with stable vital signs. An abdominal radiograph shows a foreign body in the stomach. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
opts: Whole bowel irrigation with polyethylene glycol
Induced emesis with syrup of ipecac
QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.stem: A 4-year-old girl has a continuous murmur heard best at the right upper parasternal border in the sitting position. The murmur becomes softer when she lies supine. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.stem: A 1-year-old boy has a grade 3/6 systolic ejection murmur at the left upper parasternal border and a single S2. He has mild central cyanosis. A chest radiograph shows a boot-shaped heart with decreased pulmonary vascular markings. Which of the following is the origin of this murmur?
opts: Flow across the ventricular septal defect
Flow through the patent ductus arteriosus
Increased flow across the pulmonary valve from an atrial septal defect

QB.stem: A 20-kg child with septic shock remains hypotensive with a blood pressure of 80/50 mmHg after receiving three boluses of isotonic crystalloid, totaling 60 mL/kg, over the first hour. There is no hepatomegaly or crackles. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
QB.key: B (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78A)

QB.stem: A 2-year-old boy has vesiculobullous lesions on the posterior neck. The bullae are flaccid, and some have ruptured, leaving honey-colored crusts. Which of the following is the most likely causative organism?
QB.key: A (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78A)

QB.stem: A 4-year-old girl has a few honey-crusted erosions around the mouth that appeared 3 days ago. She is afebrile and has no lesions elsewhere. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
QB.key: B (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78A)

QB.stem: A 9-year-old boy has a 6-mm, rough, hyperkeratotic, skin-colored papule on the dorsum of his right foot for 4 months. Paring the surface reveals tiny black dots. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

A lesion on the leg disappeared completely within 4 hours. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.stem: A 10-year-old boy has a well-circumscribed, yellowish-orange, hairless plaque with a verrucous surface on the scalp that has been present since birth and has become thicker recently. Which of the following statements about this lesion is correct?
opts: Benign adnexal tumors can arise within the lesion
The lesion usually regresses spontaneously by school age
Malignant transformation occurs in most patients by adolescence

QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

Laboratory studies show a serum sodium of 125 mEq/L, potassium of 7.0 mEq/L, and bicarbonate of 14 mEq/L. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.stem: A 4-year-old boy has functional constipation with hard stools every 4 days and stool-withholding behavior. opts: Mutation in the Notch signaling pathway
Defect in primary bile acid synthesis
Congenital hepatic infection causing giant cell hepatitis
QB.key: B (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78A)

QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.flag: ⚠ คีย์เขียน "A?" (ไม่แน่ใจ) — ตอบ reassure โดยเติมว่าน้ำหนักขาด BW เล็กน้อย ทารกดูดี อุจจาระเหลวสีเหลืองแบบทารกกินนมแม่

Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
QB.key: A (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78A)

The peripheral blood smear is normal. Which of the following is the most likely cause of the jaundice?
opts: Suboptimal breast milk intake with dehydration

QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.stem: A 7-year-old boy has café-au-lait macules with areas of hyperpigmentation, short stature, and a hypoplastic right thumb. QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.stem: A 4-year-old girl has an abdominal mass, pallor, and fever. Complete blood count shows hemoglobin 6.8 g/dL, white blood cell count 2,500/µL, and platelet count 40,000/µL. Which of the following is the most appropriate next investigation?
QB.key: B (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78A)

opts: Discuss the prognosis and treatment options with her
Withhold the information until she is 18 years old
Refer her to palliative care only
Reassure her that the disease will resolve after puberty

QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

opts: Repeat a tuberculin skin test in 8 weeks before deciding on treatment
Give a booster dose of BCG vaccine
QB.key: A (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78A)

QB.stem: A 13-year-old boy has had low-grade fever, weight loss, and night sweats for 2 months. There is a firm, non-tender 10 × 10 cm left supraclavicular mass. A tuberculin skin test shows 8 mm of induration. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
QB.key: B (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78A)

QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

Breastfeed and recheck glucose in 1 hour
QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.key: B (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78A)

QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.key: B (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78A)

QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.stem: A 10-year-old boy receiving a rapid intravenous infusion of vancomycin develops flushing and an itchy erythematous rash over his face, neck, and upper trunk. His blood pressure is normal, and there is no wheezing. Which of the following is the mechanism of this reaction?
QB.key: B (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78A)

QB.stem: A 3-month-old unimmunized infant has had paroxysms of coughing for 2 weeks, followed by vomiting and episodes of cyanosis. Examination shows bilateral subconjunctival hemorrhages. Which of the following is the most likely causative organism?
QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.flag: ⚠ ไม่ตามคีย์ — คีย์ตอบ D (C. trachomatis) แต่เชื้อนี้ติดจากแม่ช่วงคลอดและไม่สัมพันธ์กับพ่อที่ไอเรื้อรัง · เติมลักษณะไอเป็นชุดให้ชัด
QB.stem: A 2-month-old infant has had intermittent paroxysms of coughing with posttussive vomiting for 2 weeks and appears well between episodes. He is afebrile. His father has had a persistent cough for the past 2 months. Which of the following is the most likely causative organism?
QB.key: D (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78A)

QB.stem: A 10-year-old boy has severe epigastric pain radiating to the back and bilious vomiting. Examination shows marked epigastric tenderness, voluntary guarding, and periumbilical ecchymosis. Which of the following is the most appropriate initial investigation?
QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.stem: A 10-year-old boy with acute glomerulonephritis presents with severe headache and blurred vision. His blood pressure is 150/100 mmHg (above the 99th percentile + 5 mmHg for his age and height). Which of the following is the most appropriate initial management?
QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.stem: An 8-year-old boy has double vision, especially in the evening. His mother notices that his eyelids droop when he is tired. Pupillary responses are normal. The ice-pack test improves the ptosis. Which of the following is the most appropriate initial treatment?
QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.flag: ⚠ ไฟล์ไม่มีรูปและช้อยไม่มี secondary bacterial skin infection (ภาวะแทรกซ้อนที่พบบ่อยที่สุดของ varicella) — ตอบ encephalitis เป็นภาวะแทรกซ้อนทาง CNS ที่สัมพันธ์กับ varicella ในช้อยที่มี
QB.stem: A 5-year-old unvaccinated girl has fever and a generalized pruritic rash consisting of erythematous macules, papules, vesicles, and crusted lesions at different stages, mostly on the trunk and back. Which of the following is a recognized complication of this illness?
QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.stem: A 2-year-old boy who could previously walk independently, say several words, and feed himself has gradually lost these abilities over the past 6 months. His prenatal and perinatal histories are unremarkable. Which of the following is the most likely etiology?
QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.stem: A 2-week-old boy with normal-appearing genitalia presents with poor feeding, vomiting, lethargy, and generalized hyperpigmentation. His capillary refill time is 4 seconds. Laboratory studies show serum sodium 120 mEq/L, potassium 7.2 mEq/L, and glucose 50 mg/dL. Congenital adrenal hyperplasia with salt-wasting crisis is suspected. In addition to an isotonic saline bolus, which of the following is the most appropriate management?
QB.key: B (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: A 6-year-old boy has a waddling gait, difficulty rising from the floor with a positive Gowers sign, and pseudohypertrophy of the calf muscles. Serum creatine kinase is markedly elevated, and genetic testing confirms a dystrophin gene deletion. Which of the following is the most appropriate treatment?
QB.key: B (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: A preterm infant born at 30 weeks of gestation is now 6 weeks old. He has pallor, mild edema of the lower extremities, and is receiving oral iron supplementation. Hemoglobin and hematocrit are decreased, the reticulocyte count is 7%, and the peripheral blood smear shows acanthocytes with thrombocytosis. Deficiency of which vitamin is most likely?
QB.key: E (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.flag: ⚠ ไม่ตามคีย์ — คีย์ตอบ D (Dengue NS1 Ag) แต่ไข้วันที่ 6 NS1 ไวลดลง; CBC ช่วยได้ทั้งการวินิจฉัยและประเมิน dengue (WBC, plt, Hct) — ดู opinion
QB.stem: An 8-year-old boy has had fever, vomiting, and abdominal pain for 6 days. His older brother was admitted last week with diarrhea and shock. Hepatitis A is initially suspected. He is alert, with stable vital signs. Which of the following is the most appropriate initial investigation?
QB.key: D (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: A term infant is born to a mother with HIV infection who was diagnosed at 34 weeks of gestation and started antiretroviral therapy 2 weeks before delivery. Her viral load near delivery is unknown. The infant is classified as high risk for HIV transmission. Which of the following is the most appropriate antiretroviral prophylaxis for the infant?
QB.key: C (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: A 5-year-old girl presents with decreased urine output for 2 days. Her serum creatinine has risen from 0.4 to 1.2 mg/dL, and she is diagnosed with acute kidney injury. Which of the following is the most appropriate initial imaging investigation?
opts: Ultrasonography of the kidneys and urinary bladder
QB.key: B (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: A term newborn delivered by vacuum extraction develops a boggy, fluctuant scalp swelling that crosses the suture lines and extends to the neck. At 4 hours of age, he is pale with tachycardia, a capillary refill time of 5 seconds, and weak pulses. Venous hematocrit is 65%. Which of the following is the most appropriate immediate management?
opts: Observation with repeat hematocrit in 6 hours
QB.key: A (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: A 10-month-old girl has a high fever for 3 days and has a brief generalized seizure during the febrile period. When the fever subsides, a pink maculopapular rash appears on her trunk. Which of the following is the most likely causative organism?
QB.key: A (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: A 10-year-old girl completed a full course of rabies post-exposure vaccination after a dog bite 1 year ago. Today she is scratched by a stray cat, resulting in an abrasion with minor bleeding. Which of the following is the most appropriate post-exposure prophylaxis?
opts: Rabies vaccine on day 0 plus rabies immunoglobulin on day 0
Rabies vaccine on days 0, 3, and 7 plus rabies immunoglobulin on day 0
QB.key: A (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: A 12-year-old girl with type 1 diabetes presents with diabetic ketoacidosis. After initial fluid resuscitation, a continuous intravenous regular insulin infusion is started. Which of the following is the primary purpose of insulin therapy in this condition?
QB.key: B (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: A 4-year-old boy who is receiving antibiotics for pneumonia suddenly develops worsening dyspnea. Examination shows markedly decreased breath sounds and hyperresonance over the right hemithorax. The chest radiograph shows a hyperexpanded right hemithorax with a mediastinal shift to the left. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
QB.key: C (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: A 7-month-old infant presents with clusters of infantile spasms. Examination shows weakness of the right arm and leg. Which of the following statements about this patient is correct?
opts: MRI of the brain is expected to be normal
EEG typically shows a generalized tonic-clonic seizure pattern
The spasms usually resolve spontaneously without treatment
Tuberous sclerosis complex may be the underlying cause
Infantile spasms usually begin after 3 years of age
QB.key: D (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: A 6-week-old infant has greasy, yellowish scales on erythematous patches over the scalp, eyebrows, and behind the ears, with similar lesions in the diaper area. The infant is feeding well and does not seem bothered by itching. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.flag: ⚠ คีย์เขียนตัวอักษร C แต่ช่องเฉลยอธิบายว่า "tap ตรวจได้ แต่ให้ถ่าย X-ray lateral decubitus ดู" → ตอบ A ตามคำอธิบาย
QB.stem: A 5-year-old boy diagnosed with pneumonia was sent home on oral antibiotics. Three days later he returns with persistent high fever and dyspnea. The chest radiograph shows patchy infiltration in the right lower lung with blunting of the right costophrenic angle. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
QB.key: C (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: A 10-year-old boy with a large anterior mediastinal mass presents with facial swelling, distended neck veins, and orthopnea. A tissue biopsy is planned. Which of the following is the most appropriate approach while preparing for the procedure? (as in the previous AC)
QB.key: C (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: A 12-year-old boy presents with facial swelling, distended neck veins, and dyspnea. Chest radiograph reveals a large anterior mediastinal mass. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.flag: ⚠ คีย์ตอบ "B,D" — ช้อย D ต้นฉบับ "Yellow color" (xanthochromia) ก็เข้ากับ TBM; เปลี่ยน D เป็น "Clear and colorless" เพื่อให้เหลือคำตอบเดียว
QB.stem: A 10-year-old boy presents with low-grade fever, headache, and a 10-kg weight loss over 3 months. He has nuchal rigidity. CT of the brain with contrast reveals basal meningeal enhancement. Which of the following cerebrospinal fluid findings is most consistent with this diagnosis?
opts: White blood cell count of 500/µL with 80% neutrophils
Glucose of 80 mg/dL with a serum glucose of 90 mg/dL
QB.key: B,D (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: A 3-year-old girl presented with dyspnea and wheezing for 3 days. Physical examination showed BT 36.5 °C, RR 30/min, subcostal retraction, and expiratory wheezing. She received a short-acting beta agonist and systemic corticosteroids as initial management, and her symptoms improved. She was then given inhaled corticosteroids as controller medicine. Which is the most appropriate device for administering the controller medicine for this girl?
opts: Metered-dose inhaler with a mouthpiece spacer
Metered-dose inhaler with a face mask spacer
QB.key: B (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: A 2-year-old boy has vomiting and diarrhea for 3 days. Laboratory studies show serum Na 136, K 3.2, Cl 114, and HCO3 12 mEq/L. Urine studies show Na 30, K 15, and Cl 70 mEq/L. Which of the following is the most likely cause of his acid–base disturbance?
QB.key: C (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: A 1-month-old infant has had vomiting and diarrhea for 4 days and received antibiotics. He appears gray-blue, with oxygen saturation of 85% by pulse oximetry that does not improve with an oxygen box. Venous blood gas shows pH 7.25, PO2 189 mmHg, PCO2 33 mmHg, and base excess −7. Which of the following is the most likely cause of the low oxygen saturation?
QB.key: B (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: An 18-month-old boy does not watch television himself, but his grandmother keeps the television on throughout the day at home. Which of the following is the most appropriate advice?
opts: Minimize background television in the home environment
No change is needed because the child does not watch
QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.stem: A 9-year-old girl receiving intravenous vancomycin develops flushing and an itchy erythematous rash over her face, neck, and upper trunk about 15 minutes into the infusion. Her vital signs are stable and there is no wheezing. The infusion is stopped and an oral antihistamine is given, and the rash resolves. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
opts: Resume vancomycin at a slower infusion rate
Discontinue vancomycin permanently and label as allergic
QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.stem: Which of the following patients is most likely to benefit from noninvasive positive pressure ventilation (NPPV)?
opts: A 14-year-old boy with traumatic brain injury and facial trauma
A 2-year-old girl with pneumonitis following corrosive agent ingestion
An 8-month-old infant with abdominal distension and gastroesophageal reflux
QB.key: B (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: Which of the following patients requires antibiotic prophylaxis for infective endocarditis?
opts: Unrepaired tetralogy of Fallot undergoing flexible bronchoscopy without biopsy
Unrepaired secundum atrial septal defect undergoing tooth extraction
Patent ductus arteriosus after device closure 1 month ago undergoing tooth extraction
Ventricular septal defect repaired 5 years ago without residual defect undergoing tonsillectomy
Pulmonary atresia with intact ventricular septum after a modified Blalock-Taussig shunt undergoing voiding cystourethrography
QB.key: C+D (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: A 17-year-old sexually active boy has purulent urethral discharge and dysuria for 3 days. Gram stain of the discharge shows gram-negative intracellular diplococci. Testing for chlamydia has not been performed. Which of the following is the most appropriate treatment?
QB.key: B (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: A 13-year-old girl has short stature, absent breast development, a webbed neck, a low posterior hairline, and widely spaced nipples. Which of the following is most commonly associated with her condition?
QB.key: B (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: A 5-year-old boy with acute kidney injury has a serum potassium of 7.5 mEq/L. His EKG shows peaked T waves and widened QRS complexes. Which of the following should be given first?
QB.key: A (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.imgNote: รูปจากไฟล์ recall: แถบ EKG (ไฟล์ใส่ภาพประกอบที่มีหัวข้อชื่อ rhythm ติดมา — ครอปหัวข้อออกแล้ว)
QB.stem: A 10-year-old boy is evaluated before a sports competition. He is asymptomatic. His rhythm strip is shown. Which of the following is the rhythm?
opts: Second-degree AV block, Mobitz type I
Second-degree AV block, Mobitz type II
QB.key: B (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: A 9-year-old girl with chronic kidney disease has a serum potassium of 6.2 mEq/L. Her mother asks which foods should be avoided. Which of the following foods should she avoid?
QB.key: D (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: A preterm infant weighing 1,000 g at birth is delivered by cesarean section because of maternal preeclampsia. The mother's HBsAg is negative. The infant is medically stable. When should the hepatitis B vaccine be given?
opts: HBIG plus hepatitis B vaccine within 12 hours of birth
Hepatitis B vaccine at 1 month of age or at hospital discharge
Hepatitis B vaccine at 2 months of age
Hepatitis B vaccine within 24 hours, counted as the first dose of a three-dose series
Defer vaccination until body weight reaches 2,500 g
QB.key: B (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: A 3-month-old infant has itchy, oozing eczematous lesions on both cheeks. Which of the following best describes the pathogenesis of this condition?
opts: T cell-mediated inflammation without a role of skin barrier dysfunction
Skin barrier dysfunction from filaggrin defects with Staphylococcus aureus superantigen-driven inflammation
Immune complex deposition at the dermoepidermal junction
QB.key: B (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: Advanced paternal age is most strongly associated with an increased risk of which of the following conditions in the offspring?
QB.key: A (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: A 2-year-old boy has fever, cough, and fast breathing for 3 days. He cannot drink or eat, appears lethargic, and has chest indrawing with oxygen saturation of 89% on room air. Chest radiograph shows lobar consolidation. Which of the following is the most appropriate antibiotic?
QB.key: B (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: A 2-year-old girl has fever of 39 °C for 2 days without another source. She is well-appearing, alert, and drinking well. Urinalysis from a catheterized specimen shows pyuria and bacteriuria. She will be treated as an outpatient. Which of the following is the most appropriate antibiotic?
QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.flag: ⚠ ต้นฉบับไม่แน่ใจว่าอาการนำ 1 หรือ 2 สัปดาห์ (ผู้จดเขียนว่าถ้า 1 สัปดาห์ favor viral-induced, 2 สัปดาห์ favor ITP) — ใช้ 2 สัปดาห์
QB.stem: A 4-year-old girl develops petechiae and bruises 2 weeks after an upper respiratory tract infection that has resolved. She is otherwise well, with no hepatosplenomegaly or lymphadenopathy. CBC shows hemoglobin 12 g/dL, WBC 8,000/µL (N 40%, L 40%, E 5%), and platelet count 15,000/µL. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.stem: An 11-year-old girl is noted to have uneven shoulder heights and asymmetry of the back. On the forward bend test, a right thoracic rib hump is seen. She has no back pain or neurologic abnormality. Which of the following is the most appropriate investigation?
opts: Standing posteroanterior and lateral radiographs of the whole spine
QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.stem: Which of the following findings is most concerning for non-accidental trauma? (as in the previous AC)
opts: Torn labial frenulum in a 3-month-old infant
Bruises over both shins in a 4-year-old child
A bruise on the forehead in a 15-month-old toddler who is learning to walk
A chin laceration in a 3-year-old child after falling from a bicycle
Abrasions on both knees in a 6-year-old child
QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.stem: A 7-year-old boy with perinatally acquired HIV infection on antiretroviral therapy has a close household contact with smear-positive pulmonary tuberculosis. He is asymptomatic, with a normal physical examination and chest radiograph. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
opts: Perform a tuberculin skin test before deciding
PCR for Mycobacterium tuberculosis from gastric aspirate
Treat as latent TB infection (TB preventive treatment)
Perform an interferon-gamma release assay before deciding
QB.key: C (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: A healthy 2½-year-old boy comes for a well-child visit. He is due for his second doses of both measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccine and live attenuated Japanese encephalitis vaccine. How should these vaccines be given?
opts: Give both vaccines on the same day
Give MMR first, then JE vaccine 10 days later
Give MMR first, then JE vaccine 20 days later
Give JE vaccine first, then MMR 10 days later
Give JE vaccine first, then MMR 20 days later
QB.key: A (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: A 13-year-old boy at Tanner stage 3 notices a tender lump beneath his left nipple. Examination shows a 1-cm firm, rubbery, mobile subareolar disc. Ultrasonography shows a 0.5-cm area of glandular tissue. He takes no medications, and testicular examination is normal. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
opts: Reassure that it usually resolves within 1–2 years
Measure serum beta-hCG and refer for surgery
QB.key: A (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: A 6-year-old boy with chronic cholestatic liver disease presents with bruises over the extensor surfaces. Laboratory studies show hemoglobin 10.5 g/dL, WBC 9,800/µL, platelet count 350,000/µL, PT 31 seconds (normal 11–12), and aPTT 55 seconds (normal 28–32). Which of the following is the most likely cause of the bleeding?
QB.key: C > A (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: A 4-year-old boy develops pallor, dark urine, and jaundice 2 days after eating fava beans. He is suspected of having G6PD deficiency. Blood tests are sent on the day of admission during acute hemolysis. Which of the following results is most likely?
QB.key: A (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: A male term infant presented with hypotonia, a weak cry, and subcostal retraction. During pregnancy, his mother usually felt fatigue, even when opening her eyes and eating dinner. The next day, his physical examination reveals that he is active but still has a weak cry, subcostal retraction, and a frog-leg position. Which is the most appropriate investigation to diagnose the infant?
QB.key: B (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: An 8-year-old boy has had two brief episodes of twitching of the left side of his face with drooling and inability to speak shortly after falling asleep, without loss of awareness. Neurological examination and development are normal. EEG shows centrotemporal spikes activated by sleep. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
opts: MRI of the brain before deciding on treatment
QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.stem: A 6-year-old boy has palpable purpura on the buttocks and lower extremities, colicky abdominal pain, and swollen ankles. Platelet count and coagulation tests are normal. Which of the following is the underlying mechanism of this disease?
opts: IgA immune complex deposition in small vessels
Immune complexes with low serum complement
QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.flag: ⚠ ไม่ตามคีย์ — คีย์ตอบ D (albumin + furosemide) แต่ภาพเป็น acute nephritic syndrome ที่มี volume overload (HT, edema, effusion) → IV furosemide; albumin จะเพิ่ม volume
QB.stem: A 7-year-old boy has gross hematuria for 2 days. His blood pressure is 140/100 mmHg, with puffy eyelids and decreased breath sounds at the right lower lung. Laboratory studies show BUN 60 mg/dL, creatinine 2.5 mg/dL, and serum total CO2 10 mEq/L. Which of the following is the most appropriate initial management?
QB.key: D (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: A 4-year-old boy with newly diagnosed nephrotic syndrome has moderate generalized edema. He has normal blood pressure, warm extremities, normal capillary refill, and no abdominal pain. Prednisolone has been started. Which of the following is the most appropriate treatment for his edema?
opts: Strict fluid restriction to 30% of maintenance alone
QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.stem: A hospitalized child requires placement in a negative-pressure airborne infection isolation room. Which of the following diagnoses is most likely?
QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.stem: A toddler says 6 meaningful words and follows one-step commands without gestures. These language milestones are most typical of which of the following ages?
QB.key: C (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: A 1-day-old term infant vomits blood. He is well-appearing with stable vital signs. His mother had placental abruption during delivery. Which of the following is the most appropriate initial investigation?
QB.key: Apt test (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.flag: ⚠ ต้นฉบับจดแค่อาการ — เติมประวัติขี้เทาออกช้าและท้องอืด ให้เป็น Hirschsprung-associated enterocolitis
QB.stem: A 3-month-old boy with a history of delayed passage of meconium presents with fever, marked abdominal distension, foul-smelling bloody mucoid diarrhea, and bilious vomiting. He is kept NPO and intravenous fluids and broad-spectrum antibiotics are started. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.stem: A 1-month-old infant has jaundice with pale stools. A systolic murmur is heard over the lung fields bilaterally. The hepatobiliary scan shows delayed excretion of the radiotracer into the intestine. Which of the following is the most likely liver histopathologic finding?
opts: Obstruction of the extrahepatic biliary tract
Giant cell transformation of hepatocytes with intranuclear inclusions
Periportal fibrosis with ductal plate malformation
QB.key: A (คีย์ในไฟล์ Key AC78B)

QB.stem: Which of the following pubertal findings is pathological and warrants further evaluation?
opts: Tanner stage 2 breast development in a 6-year-old girl
Testicular enlargement to 4 mL in an 11-year-old boy
Bilateral breast enlargement in a 13-year-old boy
QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.flag: ⚠ ผู้จดจำคำถามไม่ได้ ("จำไม่ได้ละว่าถามว่าไร") — แต่งเป็นคำถามปัจจัยปกป้องด้านจิตใจในเด็กป่วยมะเร็งระยะท้าย
QB.stem: A 12-year-old boy has advanced cancer. The care team wants to support his psychological adjustment to the illness. Which of the following factors is most strongly associated with better psychological adjustment?
opts: Avoiding discussion of the illness with the child
QB.key: ไม่มีเฉลยในไฟล์ (เฉลยโดย Claude)

QB.stem: A 2-year-old boy who drinks only boiled cow's milk and refuses fruits and vegetables has irritability, refuses to walk, and lies with his legs in a frog-leg position. He has swollen, bleeding gums. Which of the following findings is most likely in this condition? (as in the previous AC)
